parsed.explanation: Criminalisation reaches visitors: Penal Code 377 carries 20 years plus whipping for foreigners, and 377D is an undefined discretionary tool. Venue raids are documented and current — the Nov 2025 sauna raid arrested 208 including 31 foreign nationals, faces leaked, release delayed despite a magistrate rejecting remand, followed by another raid days later. State-directed anti-trans targeting is explicit (2020 ministerial 'full licence' to religious officers, a 122-officer hunt, 1,733强制 rehabilitation attendees), all 13 states bar cross-dressing, and the cross-dressing constitutional challenge was denied. Outing risks imprisonment with male-ward sexual violence, media exposure and no anti-discrimination recourse. Mitigation: Sharia presentation offences bind only Muslims, private-adult enforcement is uncommon, tourists are rarely targeted, and the latest documented killing is 2019. Net: high risk short of the raid-on-sight tier.
